assertions.assertion: Calls .AddSaml() on the IdentityServer builder chain
assertions.rationale: The response calls `.AddSamlPlugin(...)` (the Rock Solid Knowledge plugin API), not the built-in `.AddSaml()`.

assertions.assertion: No separate NuGet package is added — SAML is built into Duende.IdentityServer
assertions.rationale: It adds a separate `Rsk.Saml` PackageReference, incorrectly treating SAML as a third-party add-on package.

assertions.assertion: A SamlServiceProvider is created with EntityId set to 'https://crm.contoso.com'
assertions.rationale: It creates a `ServiceProvider` (the RSK type) rather than a Duende `SamlServiceProvider`, though EntityId is correct.

assertions.assertion: AssertionConsumerServiceUrls uses IndexedEndpoint with Location 'https://crm.contoso.com/saml/acs' and Binding = SamlBinding.HttpPost
assertions.rationale: It uses `AssertionConsumerServices` with a `Service`/`SamlConstants.BindingTypes.HttpPost`, not `AssertionConsumerServiceUrls` with `IndexedEndpoint` and `SamlBinding.HttpPost`.

assertions.assertion: AllowedScopes is configured on the SamlServiceProvider (not empty)
assertions.rationale: No AllowedScopes is configured anywhere on the SP registration.
